Makes two bodies share a point and lets the second one turn freely, but only as far as a cone around the axis allows, like a hip or a shoulder. `PhysicsConstraintLimits` changes the angle.

A constraint needs bodies in the same physics world and at least one body that can move (dynamic). It is gone when either body is freed or the world is freed. All points and directions are in the world. Free it with `FreePhysicsConstraint`.
@param a The first body (a physics body entity). Limits, angles, speeds and positions of the constraint are those of this body relative to the second.
@param b The second body, or 0 to hold the first body against the world.
@param x The shared point, x.
@param y The shared point, y.
@param z The shared point, z.
@param axis_x The middle of the cone, x.
@param axis_y The middle of the cone, y.
@param axis_z The middle of the cone, z.
@param half_angle How far the axis may move from the middle, in degrees from 0 to 180.
@returns The handle of the constraint.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
